selected_component: Ontology-engineering design research with evidence synthesis + bounded operational/Pharma cases
rationale: Matches #39 and the actual evidence/application structure without overstating systematic-review status.

selected_component: OGCM-RF implementation profile with explicit decision gates
rationale: Provides evidence→decision→artifact→evaluation governance and prevents premature formalization.

selected_component: Structured mapping/scoping + exhaustive source mining + governed stopping
rationale: Needed for novelty/source-completeness claims and already passed #40/G1.

selected_component: Cross-source reconciliation + UL + anti-concepts + evidence-backed requirements/CQs
rationale: Prevents label/schema-driven modeling and freezes semantic contract before implementation.

selected_component: Reference/align external ontologies by default; import only after foundational/license gates
rationale: Protects SemRisk from false equivalence and duplicated prior art.

selected_component: UFO/gUFO + OntoUML, tested rather than assumed
rationale: Best fit to COVER/ROSE lineage and claim of well-founded operational semantics, but exact categories must be justified per construct.

selected_component: OntoUML plus construct deficit/overload/redundancy/excess diagnostics
rationale: Adapts strongest closest-program semantic-analysis practice to test modeling adequacy.
change_impact: If not feasible, claim scope must narrow.

selected_component: Modular RDF/Turtle/OWL profile
rationale: Needed for machine-readable semantics and reasoning while keeping profiles modular.

selected_component: SHACL for local structural/data constraints
rationale: RISKMAN/AIRO show executable precedent; SemRisk needs CWA constraints separate from OWL truth.

selected_component: Explicit rule/application layer separate from OWL; exact technology only if claim-required
rationale: Prevents workflow/formula/business rules from being miscast as universal ontology axioms.

selected_component: Governed field→semantic mapping from Jira/NIST schemas
rationale: Directly supports SR-C2 while prohibiting class-per-column translation.

selected_component: PostgreSQL relational twin as projection, not semantic source of truth
rationale: Adapts RiskHub operational strength but keeps ontology ownership; enables executable case and parity analysis.

selected_component: SQL↔SPARQL parity + explicit semantic-loss/OWA-CWA analysis
rationale: Needed to distinguish SemRisk from simple ontology-informed RDB redesign.
change_impact: Failure must be reported; no silent metric optimization.

selected_component: Syntax/profile + reasoning + expected entailments + negative controls
rationale: Supports formal-correctness claim without conflating it with semantic validity.

selected_component: Bounded independent expert review where feasible
rationale: Necessary for stronger semantic validity claims, but independence/eligibility must be frozen.
change_impact: Unavailable experts narrow claims; do not substitute author judgment.

selected_component: Conceptual CQs frozen pre-implementation; executable CQ regression on exact release
rationale: Prevents post-hoc test construction and directly evaluates intended semantic capabilities.
change_impact: CQ semantic changes require #7 impact review.

selected_component: Common-dimension closest-work comparison without rankings
rationale: Supports bounded differentiation while acknowledging comparator strengths and unknowns.
change_impact: New closer work can reopen comparison.

selected_component: Bounded operational↔Pharma transfer test only if evidence independence remains defensible
rationale: Supports SR-CL06 only with explicit matched/failed/unmapped cases and no universal inference.

selected_component: Immutable source/artifact/data/mapping/test/release binding
rationale: Required to make every claim refer to one reconstructable evaluated release.

selected_component: Theorem proving/model checking/probabilistic propagation
rationale: Strong prior art exists, but current Paper-1 claims do not require this burden; adding it would not create novelty.
change_impact: If future claims require proof/propagation, reopen method selection.
